en.title: The Prom
en.description:
Process the queue from left to right. 0 represents a girl and 1 represents a boy. Each boy dances with the nearest unpaired girl currently standing in front of him, and both leave the queue. If there is no girl to pair with, record -1. Output the indices of the paired girls in the order the boys appear.

The explicit standard input/output format and additional constraints on this site define the online version and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: The input contains N and a 01 string of length N, 1≤N≤100000.
en.output: Output the girl index for each boy; output -1 when there is no girl to pair with, and output an empty line if the result is empty.
en.explanation: Use a stack to store the indices of unpaired girls. When you meet a boy, pop the top of the stack; output -1 if there is no girl.
hints: Use a stack to store the indices of unpaired girls. When you meet a boy, pop the top of the stack; output -1 if there is no girl.
